title: atheropogon multisetus
intro: Atheropogon multisetus, commonly known as Chinese club moss, is a type of plant that belongs to the family Selaginellaceae. This plant has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of Atheropogon multisetus include expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which help to relieve coughs and reduce oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenoids, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
